title: YouTube search results
description: One row per video, plus free status rows that explain what was not delivered.

dataset.title: Videos
dataset.description: Every delivered video has query, videoId, url, title, channel, channelId, views, viewsText, publishedText, publishedDaysAgo, durationText, durationSeconds, isLive, badges, description and thumbnailUrl. Rows with status other than OK carry a reason instead of data.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Counters, chargedEvents, byStatus, stopReason, datasetNote and counterMismatch. shortsSkipped counts Shorts shelf entries on the pages that were read: YouTube renders them as shortsLockupViewModel rather than videoRenderer, so they never become rows and are counted here. Status codes: OK, INVALID_INPUT, DUPLICATE, NO_RESULTS_FOUND, NOT_CHECKED_LIMIT, NOT_CHECKED_TIME, NOT_CHECKED_ERROR, NOT_CHECKED_CAP, NOT_CHECKED_BILLING, NOT_CHECKED_CHARGE_UNVERIFIED. Stop reasons: spending-cap, billing-price-unknown, charge-error, dataset-write-error, deadline.
